name: iam:PassRole + kinesisanalytics:CreateApplication + kinesisanalytics:StartApplication
description: Create a Managed Apache Flink application with a privileged service execution role, start it to execute a malicious JAR from S3 with the role's credentials.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must be able to pass the target admin IAM role to kinesisanalytics.amazonaws.com

additional.description: Poll application status to confirm execution

admin: IAM role trusting kinesisanalytics.amazonaws.com with administrative permissions
S3 bucket accessible to the Flink application's execution role containing the payload JAR
lateral: IAM role trusting kinesisanalytics.amazonaws.com with elevated permissions
S3 bucket accessible to the Flink application's execution role containing the payload JAR

references.title: Actions defined by Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: IAM role ARN to pass as the Flink application service execution role (must trust kinesisanalytics.amazonaws.com)

options.name: PAYLOAD
options.description: Payload type to execute (backdoor/attach-policy, exfil/https, exfil/s3)

options.name: CODE_BUCKET
options.description: S3 bucket containing the payload JAR. Auto-resolved from the attacker code bucket if unset.

options.name: CODE_KEY
options.description: S3 key of the payload JAR within CODE_BUCKET. Auto-resolved from the payload's JAR key if unset.

options.name: LOCAL_JAR
options.description: Local path to the payload JAR to upload to the attacker code bucket. Required when using the attacker code bucket and the JAR has not been uploaded yet. Example: ../pathfinding-labs/.../exploit-jar/exploit.jar

options.name: APP_NAME
options.description: Managed Apache Flink application name (auto-generated if unset)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for the Flink application

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Stop and delete the Flink application after execution (requires kinesisanalytics:StopApplication and kinesisanalytics:DeleteApplication)

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach an IAM policy to a user or role via a Managed Apache Flink application running with an admin execution role

payloads.name: exfil/https
payloads.description: Exfiltrate execution role credentials to an attacker HTTPS endpoint via a Managed Apache Flink application

payloads.name: exfil/s3
payloads.description: Exfiltrate execution role credentials to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket via a Managed Apache Flink application
